harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver. It securely routes RFC822 input by case-insensitive X-Department header name, preserves message bytes, and creates unique Maildir deliveries. Functionality and persistence were verified across a node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced the general-only, fixed-filename script with a POSIX shell implementation compatible with RHEL 10.
Created accounts, support, and general Maildir cur/new/tmp structures with restrictive permissions.
Verified routing using the staged samples, including lowercase and uppercase header names.
Verified byte-for-byte integrity with cmp and SHA-256 hashes.
Verified repeated-subject messages remain separate deliveries.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot identity and a successful post-reboot delivery.
Retained all three staged sample files; no temporary staging files remain.

evidence.requirement: Restore a compatible executable mail-processing entry point
evidence.summary: Diagnosed the defective fixed-name script, installed the replacement atomically, and validated its syntax, ownership, permissions, and SELinux context.

evidence.requirement: Route accounts, support, and untagged messages correctly with case-insensitive header names
evidence.summary: The uppercase accounts header routed to accounts, lowercase support header routed to support, and the untagged sample routed to general.

evidence.requirement: Preserve message bytes and keep repeated subjects as separate deliveries
evidence.summary: cmp and SHA-256 proved every delivery byte-identical to its source; two general messages with the same subject existed under distinct filenames.

evidence.requirement: Retain staged samples and leave secure, clean state
evidence.summary: All three samples remain unchanged, staging directories are empty, mailbox directories are mode 0700, and delivered messages are mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after work, node1 remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Baseline boot ID 655710bc-9cfe-438a-903c-6fe21aee76a4 was captured with healthy data; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to f98ddbec-ee9d-46bb-9b0f-b752923cd735; system health, stored deliveries, samples, and a fresh post-reboot support delivery were verified.

attempts.summary: Restored /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver. It securely routes RFC822 input by case-insensitive X-Department header name, preserves message bytes, and creates unique Maildir deliveries. Functionality and persistence were verified across a node1 reboot.
